intent: To demonstrate that Black men are far more likely than Black women to report being unfairly stopped by police due to their race or ethnicity.

requirements.question: Should the video be required to state that Black men's relative_value is higher than Black women's?

units.claim: Black men have a higher relative_value than Black women on the unfair-stop measure.
accept: Black men are more likely than Black women to report this experience on the relative measure.
The relative_value for Black men exceeds that for Black women.
Black men's relative measure is higher than Black women's.
The visual comparison shows Black men above Black women.
units.evidence: The chart must visually encode Black men's relative_value as greater than Black women's so the direction of difference is clear.

optional_valid: Black adults' relative_value is closer to Black women's than to Black men's (adults-to-women gap 0.1213 vs adults-to-men gap 0.1773).
Black adults' relative_value is below the midpoint between Black men and Black women on the relative scale.

g0_data_completeness.selection: all role=bar data rows; annotation rows excluded

clip_hardcase.reason: The reference SVG has no explicit data-role=bar mark, so visual-unit reconstruction needs manual review.

hardcases.handling: Requires human visual inspection before semantic scoring.
